name: Aurora
description: The shifting border between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor and the eclipsed realm where living things calcify.

timeline.summary: Rhain carries the calcifying Cerys toward the border, but she turns to stone from the waist down as they enter the aurora.
timeline.quote: Cerys was stone from the waist down.

timeline.summary: Rhain and Cerys turn to stone in each other's arms in the eclipsed realm.
timeline.quote: as Rhain and Cerys turned to stone in each other's arms.
